verdict.rationale: Working Copy's AI features are opt-in: the site says it "Respects your data with opt-in." Its docs say AI commit suggestions require sending staged diffs to OpenAI, so not opting in keeps repository data out of AI services. Nothing in the evidence addresses model training or what OpenAI may do with diffs once a user opts in. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or guarantee, documentation of training terms with OpenAI for opted-in data, a dedicated training opt-out control, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
